objective: Verify whether the catalogue contains a product matching the description: Cleaning Liquid from Tork in the Tork Heavy Duty T 3NB-FIT Cleaning Liquid line with cleaner type multi surface cleaner and wifi-enabled.

params.product_search_method: SELECT * FROM product_variants WHERE brand = 'Tork' AND product_name LIKE '%Cleaning Liquid%' AND (series = 'Tork Heavy Duty T 3NB-FIT Cleaning Liquid' OR model = 'Tork Heavy Duty T 3NB-FIT Cleaning Liquid')
params.property_check_method: SELECT property_key, property_value_text FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = $product.sku AND property_key IN ('cleaner type', 'wifi-enabled')
